newsitem.title: USA: Lunar Corp Q3 sales disappoint, net rises.
newsitem.headline: Lunar Corp Q3 sales disappoint, net rises.

text.p: Lunar Corp said Monday its earnings and sales rose in the third quarter ended March 31, although sales did not meet its expectations.

Lunar reported net income of $3.3 million, or $0.36 a share, compared to $2.6 million, or $0.29, in the same period a year ago. Sales in the quarter climbed to $19.9 million from $17.3 million due to continuing strong demand for its DXP-IQ product line, the company said.

But Lunar said sales were somewhat below expectations because of lower-than-anticipated sales in Japan. The company also said it does not expect substantial sales in the immediate future from its recently unveiled bone densitometer even though it has recently received 501(k) registration from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
Lunar develops products to monitor and diagnose osteoporosis and other diseases.
Its shares were off 9-3/8 Monday at 19-7/8.
